available.quote: The holder of a license as a registered nurse under the laws of another state or territory or province of Canada may be granted a license as a registered nurse in this state without examination if the holder's credentials of general and professional educational qualifications and other qualifications are comparable to those required in this state

requirements.value: Credentials of general and professional educational qualifications and other qualifications comparable to those required in Wisconsin, board must be satisfied that applicant is currently competent to practice.
requirements.quote: The holder of a license as a registered nurse under the laws of another state or territory or province of Canada may be granted a license as a registered nurse in this state without examination if the holder's credentials of general and professional educational qualifications and other qualifications are comparable to those required in this state during the same period and if the board is satisfied from the holder's employment and professional record that the holder is currently competent to practice the profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud in obtaining or renewing the license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud in the procuring or renewal of the license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: One or more violations of the nursing subchapter or any rule adopted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: One or more violations of this subchapter or any rule adopted by the board under the authority of this subchapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acts showing the nurse to be unfit or incompetent by reason of negligence, alcohol/drug abuse, or mental incompetency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acts that show the registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, or licensed practical nurse to be unfit or incompetent by reason of negligence, abuse of alcohol or other drugs, or mental incompetency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any state or federal law regulating prescribing or dispensing drugs or devices, if the person may issue prescription orders
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of any state or federal law that regulates prescribing or dispensing drugs or devices, if the person may issue prescription orders under s. 441.09 (2).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of requirements of s. 253.10(3)(c) 2., 3., 4., 5., 6. or 7.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of the requirements of s. 253.10 (3) (c) 2., 3., 4., 5., 6. or 7.

insurance_required.quote: No person may practice advanced practice registered nursing unless he or she at all times has in effect malpractice liability insurance coverage evidenced by personal liability coverage in the amounts specified for health care providers under s. 655.23 (4)

definition_quote.value: "Professional nursing" means the performance for compensation of any act in the observation or care of the ill, injured, or infirm, or for the maintenance of health or prevention of illness of others, that requires substantial nursing skill, knowledge, or training, or application of nursing principles based on biological, physical, and social sciences.
definition_quote.quote: "Professional nursing" means the performance for compensation of any act in the observation or care of the ill, injured, or infirm, or for the maintenance of health or prevention of illness of others, that requires substantial nursing skill, knowledge, or training, or application of nursing principles based on biological, physical, and social sciences.

value: observation and recording of symptoms and reactions
execution of procedures and techniques in treatment under physician/podiatrist/chiropractor/dentist/optometrist supervision or order
execution of general nursing procedures and techniques
supervision of a patient and supervision and direction of licensed practical nurses and less skilled assistants
methods_authorized.quote: Professional nursing includes any of the following: (a) The observation and recording of symptoms and reactions. (b) The execution of procedures and techniques in the treatment of the sick under the general or special supervision or direction of a physician, podiatrist licensed under ch. 448, chiropractor licensed under ch. 446, dentist licensed under ch. 447, or optometrist licensed under ch. 449... (c) The execution of general nursing procedures and techniques. (d) Except as provided in s. 50.04 (2) (b), the supervision of a patient and the supervision and direction of licensed practical nurses and less skilled assistants.

drug_authority.value: APRNs may issue prescription orders subject to board rules; specific drugs or devices may be excluded by rule
drug_authority.quote: an advanced practice registered nurse may issue prescription orders, subject to the rules promulgated under sub. (6) (a) 1. and 4.

value: advanced practice registered nurse (APRN) - with specialty designations: certified nurse-midwife (CNM), certified registered nurse anesthetist (CRNA), clinical nurse specialist (CNS), nurse practitioner (NP)
license_tiers.quote: "Advanced practice registered nursing" means the practice of a certified nurse-midwife, the practice of a certified registered nurse anesthetist, the practice of a clinical nurse specialist, and the practice of a nurse practitioner.

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Recognized role" means one of the following roles: (a) Certified nurse-midwife. (b) Certified registered nurse anesthetist. (c) Clinical nurse specialist. (d) Nurse practitioner.

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "Practical nursing" means the performance for compensation of any simple acts in the care of convalescent, subacutely or chronically ill, injured or infirm persons, or of any act or procedure in the care of the more acutely ill, injured or infirm under the specific direction of a nurse, physician, podiatrist licensed under ch. 448, chiropractor licensed under ch. 446, dentist licensed under ch. 447 or optometrist licensed under ch. 449

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse licensed under this section may, except as provided in subd. 2. and par. (b), practice advanced practice registered nursing only in collaboration with a physician or dentist.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse to whom par. (a) 1. applies may, except as provided in pars. (bg) 1. and (c), practice advanced practice registered nursing in a recognized role without being supervised by or collaborating with, and independent of, a physician or dentist if the board verifies, upon application of the advanced practice registered nurse, that the advanced practice registered nurse satisfies all of the following:

full_independent_practice_experience_hou.quote: The advanced practice registered nurse has completed 3,840 hours of professional nursing in a clinical setting.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: an advanced practice registered nurse may issue prescription orders, subject to the rules promulgated under sub. (6) (a) 1. and 4.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse licensed under this section may delegate a task or order to another clinically trained health care worker if the task or order is within the scope of the advanced practice registered nurse's practice, the advanced practice registered nurse is competent to perform the task or issue the order, and the advanced practice registered nurse has reasonable evidence that the health care worker is minimally competent to perform the task or issue the order under the circumstances.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: This subsection does not apply to any registered nurse who holds a multistate license, as defined in s. 441.51 (2) (h), issued by a jurisdiction, other than this state, that has adopted the nurse licensure compact.

multistate_license_option_available.quote: The board shall grant a multistate license, as defined in s. 441.51 (2) (h), to an applicant for a multistate registered nurse license under s. 441.51.

nurse_practitioner_transition_to_practic.quote: The advanced practice registered nurse has completed 3,840 clinical hours of advanced practice registered nursing practice in that recognized role while working with a physician or dentist who was immediately available for consultation and accepted responsibility for the actions of the advanced practice registered nurse during those 3,840 hours of practice.

cnm_out_of_hospital_birth_authorized.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse with a certified nurse-midwife specialty designation may not offer to deliver babies outside of a hospital setting unless the advanced practice registered nurse files with the board, and the board approves, a proactive plan
